source.name: BBC World News RSS
source.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
source.summary: Russia is accused of growing increasingly reckless after Berlin blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport.
source.evidence_text:
Germany attributed an unsuccessful drone attack at Leipzig airport to Russia.
European Commission and Nato leaders promised a stronger response and increased pressure on Russia.
Russia denied responsibility for targeting a Ukrainian cargo aircraft at the airport.
A robot was used to make an explosive drone safe.
The airport serves as a Nato hub and is used by Ukrainian transport aircraft.
Germany announced plans to shut the Russian consulate in Bonn and a Russian cultural institution in Berlin.
Russia announced the closure of German cultural centres in response to Germany’s measures.
European foreign ministers discussed enforcing sanctions more tightly and further restrictions on visas.
Nato’s leader expressed support for Germany.
European leaders characterised Russian actions as increasingly reckless.
source.evidence_kind: Editor-written factual notes paraphrased from the linked BBC article; not quotations or independent reporting.

lesson.title: Europe responds to an accusation
lesson.overview: Keep an accusation separate from a proven fact.
lesson.prediction: Read the title. What do you think the story is about?
discussion: What happened? Start with: The report says ___.
Think about a claim you might hear. Complete: Before I believe it, I can check ___.
news_brief_sentences: Germany has blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport.
Russia says it did not carry out the attack.
A robot made an explosive drone safe.
The airport is used by Ukrainian transport planes.
The EU and Nato say they will put more pressure on Russia.
Russia is accused of acting more recklessly.
